type.quote: The commission may adopt such rules as it deems necessary to carry out this chapter.

degree_required.value: Graduation from a dental college, school, or dental department of an institution approved by the commission
degree_required.quote: Present satisfactory evidence of graduation from a dental college, school, or dental department of an institution approved by the commission

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: a general practice residency, pediatric residency, or advanced education in general dentistry residency program in Washington state accredited by the commission on dental accreditation of the American dental association

required.quote: The commission shall accept, in lieu of the practical examination required in (a) of this subsection, proof that an applicant has satisfactorily completed a general practice residency, pediatric residency, or advanced education in general dentistry residency program

duration.quote: of at least one year's duration, in a residency program that serves predominantly low-income patients

kind.value: general practice residency, pediatric residency, or advanced education in general dentistry residency
kind.quote: a general practice residency, pediatric residency, or advanced education in general dentistry residency program

exams.name: Dentistry Licensing Examination (practical and written)
exams.notes: Commission may accept a certificate from a national or regional testing organization in lieu of all or part of the written examination.
exams.quote: Pass an examination prepared or approved by and administered under the direction of the commission. The dentistry licensing examination shall consist of practical and written tests upon such subjects and of such scope as the commission determines.

required.quote: Every person licensed to practice dentistry in this state shall renew his or her license and comply with administrative procedures, administrative requirements, continuing education requirements, and fees as provided in RCW 43.70.250 and 43.70.280.

available.quote: An applicant holding a valid license and currently engaged in practice in another state may be granted a license without examination required by this chapter, on the payment of any required fees

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license in another state and be currently engaged in practice; must be a graduate of an approved dental college or have practiced at least four years in another state plus completed a one-year postdoctoral residency approved by the commission.
requirements.quote: Is a graduate of a dental college, school, or dental department of an institution approved by the commission under RCW 18.32.040(1); or Has practiced in another state for at least four years; and Has completed a one-year postdoctoral residency approved by the commission.

title_protection.quote: The fact that a person uses any dental degree, or designation, or any card, device, directory, poster, sign, or other media whereby he or she represents himself or herself to be a dentist, shall be prima facie evidence that such person is engaged in the practice of dentistry.

scope_protection.quote: No person, unless previously licensed to practice dentistry in this state, shall begin the practice of dentistry in this state without first applying to, and obtaining a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross, willful, or continued overcharging for professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the term 'unprofessional conduct' as used in RCW 18.32.530 through 18.32.755 includes gross, willful, or continued overcharging for professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting third-party payment as full payment in abrogation of copayment provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unprofessional conduct under this chapter and chapter 18.130 RCW for a dentist to abrogate the copayment provisions of a contract by accepting the payment received from a third party payer as full payment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing fraudulent, false, or misleading statements about skill or method of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, firm, or corporation to publish, directly or indirectly, or circulate any fraudulent, false, or misleading statements within the state of Washington as to the skill or method of practice of any person or operator

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a dental hygienist to perform operations required to be performed by a dentist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any licensed dentist who shall permit any dental hygienist operating under his or her supervision to perform any operation required to be performed by a dentist under the provisions of this chapter shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or retaining an unlicensed person as a dental operator
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No manager, proprietor, partnership, or association owning, operating, or controlling any room, office, or dental parlors, where dental work is done, provided, or contracted for, shall employ or retain any unlicensed person or dentist as an operator

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising dental services without including the names of all persons practicing dentistry at each office location
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any advertisement or announcement for dental services must include for each office location advertised the names of all persons practicing dentistry at that office location.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to permanently mark complete dentures and removable dental prostheses with patient identification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of any dentist to comply with RCW 18.32.695 and 18.32.705 is a violation for which the dentist may be subject to proceedings

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlicensed person or entity interfering with a licensed dentist's independent clinical judgment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person that is not licensed under this chapter or an entity that is not a professional entity practices dentistry in violation of this chapter, and subject to enforcement under RCW 18.130.190, if the person or entity interferes with a licensed dentist's independent clinical judgment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Neglecting, ignoring, abandoning, or refusing to complete a current procedure for a patient without reasonable cause
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The attending dentist, without reasonable cause, must not neglect, ignore, abandon, or refuse to complete the current procedure for a patient.

definition_quote.value: A person practices dentistry, within the meaning of this chapter, who (1) represents himself or herself as being able to diagnose, treat, remove stains and concretions from teeth, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw, or (2) offers or undertakes by any means or methods to diagnose, treat, remove stains or concretions from teeth, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the same, or take impressions of the teeth or jaw, or (3) owns, maintains, or operates an office for the practice of dentistry, or (4) engages in any of the practices included in the curricula of recognized and approved dental schools or colleges, or (5) professes to the public by any method to furnish, supply, construct, reproduce, or repair any prosthetic denture, bridge, appliance, or other structure to be worn in the human mouth.

drug_authority.value: Registered pharmacists may fill prescriptions of legally licensed dentists for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry.
drug_authority.quote: Registered pharmacists of this state may fill prescriptions of legally licensed dentists of this state for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry.

value: supervision of a licensed dentist or dental therapist
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: Such licensed dental hygienists may perform dental operations and services only under the supervision of a licensed dentist or dental therapist

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Enter into a written practice arrangement plan, approved by the department, with a dentist licensed in this state, under which the dentist will provide off-site supervision of the dental services provided.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: dental hygienists licensed under this chapter with two years' practical clinical experience with a licensed dentist within the preceding five years may be employed, retained, or contracted by health care facilities and senior centers to perform authorized dental hygiene operations and services without dental supervision.

value: patients, students, and residents of health care facilities
persons sixty years of age or older at senior centers
low-income, rural, and other at-risk populations in community-based sealant programs in schools
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: The performance of dental hygiene operations and services in health care facilities shall be limited to patients, students, and residents of the facilities.

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: by dental therapists licensed under chapter 18.265 RCW

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation shall practice dentistry or shall solicit through itself, or its agent, officers, employees, directors or trustees, dental patronage for any dentists or dental surgeon employed by any corporation

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: By January 1, 2019, the commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: the making, repairing, altering, or supplying of artificial restorations, substitutions, appliances, or materials for the correction of disease, loss, deformity, malposition, dislocation, fracture, injury to the jaws, teeth, lips, gums, cheeks, palate, or associated tissues or parts; providing the same are made, repaired, altered, or supplied pursuant to the written instructions and order of a licensed dentist

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper and lower denture and removable dental prosthesis fabricated by a dentist licensed under this chapter, or fabricated pursuant to the dentist's work order or under the dentist's direction or supervision, shall be marked with the name of the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended.

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: A person who holds a license under this chapter and who has met the requirements under RCW 18.260.050 and has been issued a license to practice as an expanded function dental auxiliary may perform those expanded function dental auxiliary services identified in RCW 18.260.070

patient_record_retention_years.quote: the prescriptions shall be retained and filed for a period of not less than three years and shall be available to and subject to the examination of the secretary or the secretary's authorized representatives

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: dental hygienists licensed under this chapter with two years' practical clinical experience with a licensed dentist within the preceding five years may be employed, retained, or contracted by health care facilities and senior centers to perform authorized dental hygiene operations and services without dental supervision.
